legal.privacyPolicyText:
[Introduction]
This tool (hereinafter referred to as "the Tool") is highly committed to protecting the privacy of its users. While maintaining our fundamental local-first design, the Tool securely handles minimal necessary data for account authentication and party-sharing features provided upon user choice.

[Local Data Processing (Guest Use)]
When using the Tool without signing in, all of the following operations and data storage are performed entirely within your web browser (local environment):
1. Damage calculations and durability/damage index computation
2. Local creation and editing of party data (stored in IndexedDB and localStorage)
Custom parameters and configurations entered during guest use are never automatically uploaded, stored, or processed on external servers.

[Account Authentication and Collected Information]
When a user voluntarily signs in using a Google or X (formerly Twitter) account (OAuth 2.0 authentication), the Tool receives and securely manages the following information from the authentication provider:
- Unique account identifier (ID) provided by the auth provider
- Display name (nickname)
- Email address (Google sign-in only)
- Profile avatar URL
This information is strictly used to maintain active sessions, manage party ownership and synchronization, and prevent unauthorized access.

[Use of Cookies and Session Tokens]
The Tool uses cryptographically signed first-party cookies solely to maintain login sessions (poke_session) and prevent CSRF attacks during OAuth authentication (poke_oauth_state). We do not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising tracking tools.

[Cloud Sync and Public Party Information]
When an authenticated user syncs party data to the cloud or publishes it to the party ranking, the party build (Pokémon, EV spreads, move sets), custom trainer name (defaulting to "Anonymous Trainer" if unspecified), rental team ID, article URL, and description are stored in our cloud database.
Parties set to public will be visible and accessible to all users on the Tool's ranking board.

[Changes to this Policy]
We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time to reflect tool updates or legal changes. The updated policy becomes effective immediately upon publication within the Tool.
legal.disclaimerText:
[Relationship with Official Entities]
This tool is an unofficial fan-made battle analytics tool and has no affiliation with Nintendo Co., Ltd., Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc., The Pokémon Company, or any other official entities.

[Accuracy of Calculations and Information]
Damage indices, durability indices, and final stats calculated by this tool are estimates based on mathematical formulas. We do not guarantee exact parity with actual in-game damage rolls, mechanics, or edge cases.

[User-Generated Content (UGC), Public Parties, and External Links]
The Tool bears no responsibility for the accuracy, legality, safety, or quality of user-generated party builds, rental team IDs, descriptions, trainer names, or external links (e.g., Note, personal blogs, social media) published to the party ranking or shared by users. The developer is not responsible for any disputes or damages arising from external websites.

[Cloud Sync and Service Outages]
The developer assumes no liability for any loss, corruption, delay, or failure to recover cloud-synchronized party data resulting from network failures, cloud infrastructure (e.g., Cloudflare) disruptions, maintenance, or authentication issues.

[Right to Remove Inappropriate Content]
The developer reserves the right to unpublish, edit, or delete any public party, description, or author name that violates public order, contains defamatory remarks, or infringes upon intellectual property rights, without prior notice.

[General Disclaimer]
The developer shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or exemplary damages (including battle defeats, data loss, hardware issues, or other disadvantages) arising from the use of this tool. Use of this tool is entirely at your own discretion and risk.

[External APIs and Resources]
This tool uses third-party APIs (such as PokeAPI) to obtain data. We provide no warranty or compensation for disruptions or functional defects resulting from changes or downtime in these external services.

[Copyright and Intellectual Property]
All Pokémon names, game data, and pixel sprite assets used in this tool belong to Nintendo Co., Ltd., Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc., The Pokémon Company, and their respective rights holders.
This non-commercial secondary creation tool is developed for fan research and battle simulation purposes, with no intent to infringe any copyright. Image assets are non-commercially cited under public domain/open-source licenses (PokeAPI) and fair use principles. If requested by copyright holders, content will be promptly reviewed and removed.
legal.termsOfServiceText:
[Article 1 (Scope of Agreement)]
These Terms of Service (hereinafter "Terms") set forth the terms and conditions for using this tool between the user (hereinafter "User") and the developer. By using this tool, the User is deemed to have agreed to all provisions of these Terms and the Disclaimer.

[Article 2 (Account and Authentication)]
1. Users are solely responsible for managing their linked Google or X (formerly Twitter) accounts.
2. The developer assumes no responsibility for any damage resulting from unauthorized access, account compromise, or mismanagement of third-party login credentials.

[Article 3 (User-Generated Content and Public Parties)]
1. Regarding party configurations, trainer names, descriptions, and external URLs published by the User to the Party Ranking (hereinafter "User Content"), the User warrants that they hold legitimate rights and do not infringe on the rights of any third party.
2. Users must not publish User Content that contains offensive, defamatory, harassing, or illegal material, or unauthorized URLs.
3. The developer reserves the right to unpublish, modify, or delete any User Content deemed in violation of these Terms without prior notice.

[Article 4 (Prohibited Conduct)]
Users shall not engage in any of the following activities:
1. Tampering with or unauthorized reverse-engineering of the Tool's source code or underlying algorithms.
2. Commercial redistribution, resale, or replication of the Tool or its services.
3. Excessive automated scraping, crawling, bulk downloading, or denial-of-service attempts against the Tool, its APIs, or hosting infrastructure.
4. Fraudulent manipulation, vote stacking, botting, or artificial inflation of party ranking scores or like counts.
5. Impersonating other users or attempting to tamper with another user's party data.
6. Data mining or unauthorized scraping conducted by competing commercial services.
7. Any other conduct that causes detriment to the developer or third parties, or violates applicable laws.

[Article 5 (Service Modifications, Termination, and Access Restrictions)]
1. The Tool is provided "AS IS". The developer reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the Tool at any time without prior notice.
2. In the event of a breach of these Terms, the developer may revoke account authentication, terminate sync capabilities, or block IP access without prior notice.

[Article 6 (Governing Law and Jurisdiction)]
These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Japan. Any disputes arising out of or in connection with the Tool shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Japan as the court of first instance.
